mapper.select: SELECT e.*, s.school_name AS school_name, g.grade_name AS grade_name, CASE e.type WHEN 1 THEN '期中考试' WHEN 2 THEN '期末考试' WHEN 3 THEN '月考' WHEN 4 THEN '模拟考试' ELSE '其他' END AS type_name, CASE e.status WHEN 0 THEN '草稿' WHEN 1 THEN '待考试' WHEN 2 THEN '考试中' WHEN 3 THEN '阅卷中' WHEN 4 THEN '已完成' WHEN 5 THEN '已发布' ELSE '未知状态' END AS status_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam_subject es WHERE es.exam_id = e.id AND es.deleted = 0) AS subject_count FROM exam e LEFT JOIN school s ON s.id = e.school_id LEFT JOIN grade g ON g.id = e.grade_id WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.deleted = 0

SELECT e.*, s.school_name AS school_name, g.grade_name AS grade_name, CASE e.type WHEN 1 THEN '期中考试' WHEN 2 THEN '期末考试' WHEN 3 THEN '月考' WHEN 4 THEN '模拟考试' ELSE '其他' END AS type_name, CASE e.status WHEN 0 THEN '草稿' WHEN 1 THEN '待考试' WHEN 2 THEN '考试中' WHEN 3 THEN '阅卷中' WHEN 4 THEN '已完成' WHEN 5 THEN '已发布' ELSE '未知状态' END AS status_name, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exam_subject es WHERE es.exam_id = e.id AND es.deleted = 0) AS subject_count FROM exam e INNER JOIN exam_score score ON score.exam_id = e.id LEFT JOIN school s ON s.id = e.school_id LEFT JOIN grade g ON g.id = e.grade_id WHERE score.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.status = 5 ORDER BY COALESCE(e.end_time, e.start_time, e.create_time) DESC, e.id DESC
